summary: Verified z-index bug fix for cancellation modal ('Why are you cancelling?'). Modal at z-index 9999 renders correctly on top of dark backdrop (bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm). All Leaflet panes (.leaflet-pane, .leaflet-top, .leaflet-bottom) are capped at z-index 400 via global CSS in /app/frontend/src/index.css. Verified via computed styles + visual screenshot: map tiles/attribution/controls are properly darkened behind the modal, no bleed-through. Full flow tested: quick-login-rider-btn -> active ride shown -> cancel-ride-btn -> cancel-ride-modal opens -> 6 reason radios present (weather/breakdown/behaviour/safety/route/other) -> keep-ride-btn closes modal cleanly. Feedback modal uses same z-[9999] class (App.js line 2019) so same fix applies.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is >2000 lines (line 2019 for feedback modal). Recommend splitting into modules (RiderView, DriverView, AdminView, modals/) for maintainability.
Two cancellation/feedback modal JSX blocks both use identical wrapper classes 'fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm ...'. Consider extracting a <Modal> wrapper component (DRY).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The z-index modal fix is verified working. Cancel modal z=9999, feedback modal z=9999, all leaflet panes z=400 (via index.css global rule). Landing page has a marketing hero; users must click 'Log In' link in header to reach the login screen where quick-login-*-btn testids are located. After quick-login as rider, an active ride is auto-created so cancel-ride-btn is immediately available.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Leaflet's default z-index on .leaflet-pane and .leaflet-top/.leaflet-bottom controls is 1000/800, exceeding Tailwind's z-50 (used previously for the cancellation modal). Fix applied by main agent: (1) modal wrapper upgraded to z-[9999], (2) global CSS override in index.css caps .leaflet-pane, .leaflet-top, .leaflet-bottom at z-index 400 !important. Verified both are active via getComputedStyle.
